subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this broad production field report open as a routing umbrella, or split/link the remaining slices to focused canonical issues and retire it?
rationale: The remaining work spans config recovery policy, Discord/message recovery, cron ergonomics, setup auth behavior, update process handling, and resource policy, so automation cannot choose the tracking shape or product defaults safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link validated config and Discord slices to canonical issues, open any missing focused follow-ups with current-main evidence, and then close this broad tracker.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed, rejected, or moved, accepting weaker automation signal because the report spans several owners.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close now with links to existing narrower work and ask reporters to file new focused issues if weaker slices recur on current main.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link validated config and Discord slices to canonical issues, open any missing focused follow-ups with current-main evidence, and then close this broad tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a cross-surface issue-routing and product-scope decision, and this owner has the broadest relevant docs, Discord, config, and onboarding history in the evidence map.
